verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm Netlify's core value prop: connect a repo (GitHub integration), auto-detect and build, auto-deploy on push, with PR previews and one-click rollback — no manual build config needed. Community testimonials (netlify-comm-7, netlify-comm-10) independently corroborate the GitHub integration and automated build/deploy/preview experience. missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of zero-config framework auto-detection across diverse stacks, and one community report (netlify-comm-12) shows friction when custom build/dev config is needed, suggesting non-trivial setups may require manual netlify.toml tweaks.
